observability_triage.rationale: The client delegates mounting orientation to the designer and supplies only the subjective criterion 'cleanest connector layout.' No orientation, connector order, edge allocation, clearance threshold, or routing metric is fixed, so different incompatible layouts could all claim compliance.

evidence: 'Cleanest' has no frozen geometric or electrical definition.
Adapting a future enclosure does not constrain the current PCB deterministically.
missing_observables: A chosen board orientation or an objective scoring rule
Explicit connector edge, ordering, clearance, or cable-routing constraints
blocker_or_exclusion.reentry_condition: Re-enter only after the client supplies a concrete orientation or measurable connector-layout constraints.

uncovered_items.evidence: The only selection rule is subjective and cannot produce an implementation-independent binary test.
uncovered_items.required_action: Exclude this target from deterministic RQ4 unless the re-entry condition is met.
